title: Film A Man Called Adam
summary: Carter was musical director and arranger for the Sammy Davis Jr. film.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Now to pick up a few little items now. With regard to films, when I asked you about films, I didn't mention "A Man Called Adam".
That was a film, I think, for which you had a major responsibility.

Well, you know, I was the musical director on it, and I did all of the arranging in the picture, and did what the background scoring that was to be done on it. That starred Sammy Davis, Jr. -- I think that was about 1965, wasn't it?
Sixty-five, sixty-six, yes. And I went to New York, spent, oh, four to six weeks probably, doing that.
